description: This file is a unit test class for the EmailSubscriberDao in the OrangeHRM project. It tests CRUD operations related to email subscribers in the HR management system.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing EmailSubscriberDao functionalities within the OrangeHRM HR management system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of EmailSubscriberDao, and populates test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetEmailSubscribersList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of email subscribers associated with a specific email subscription ID.

methods.name: testGetEmailSubscriberById
methods.description: Tests fetching a single email subscriber by ID and verifying its properties.

methods.name: testSaveEmailSubscriber
methods.description: Tests saving (creating) a new email subscriber and verifies the saved data.

methods.name: testEditEmailSubscriber
methods.description: Tests editing an existing email subscriber and verifying updated properties.

methods.name: testDeleteSubscriber
methods.description: Tests deleting email subscribers by their IDs.
